speaker: Doctor
text: Greeting, I am Dr. Agent. You have a history of gait and limb ataxia; to begin our investigation, have you noticed any recent changes in your vision, such as double vision or blurring?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: You mentioned clumsiness is especially on the right side; is this ataxia new, or have you had similar episodes before? Additionally, do you experience any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your limbs?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.

Based on your history of Crohn's disease treated with natalizumab and your new onset of gait and limb ataxia, this presentation is highly suspicious for PML. We need to confirm this immediately; can you confirm if you have noticed any vision changes or headaches? REQUEST IMAGES: Brain MRI.
